command: set -o pipefail; echo '=== CONFIG RELEVANT ==='; sudo -n grep -E '^(ENTITYOS_(ROOTFS_RUN|DATA_DIR|VOICE_DIR|COGNITION_DIR|IDENTITY_BINDS|MACHINE_NAME))=' /etc/entityos/entityos.conf 2>/dev/null || true; echo '=== DB READONLY SHAPES ==='; for p in /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/agentzero/consciousness.db /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/agentzero/unified.db /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/frank/db/amygdala.db /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/frank/db/world_experience.db; do echo DB:$p; sudo -n sqlite3 "file:$p?mode=ro" 'PRAGMA integrity_check; SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type="table" AND name NOT LIKE "sqlite_%" ORDER BY name;' 2>&1 | sed -n '1,100p'; done; echo '=== OPEN HOLDERS ==='; if command -v lsof >/dev/null; then sudo -n lsof /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/agentzero/consciousness.db /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/agentzero/unified.db /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/frank/db/amygdala.db /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/frank/db/world_experience.db 2>/dev/null || true; else for p in /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/agentzero/consciousness.db /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/agentzero/unified.db /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/frank/db/amygdala.db /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/frank/db/world_experience.db; do sudo -n fuser -v "$p" 2>&1 || true; done; fi; echo '=== CONTAINER PROCESSES ==='; machinectl status entityos --no-pager 2>/dev/null | sed -n '1,120p' || true; ps -eo pid,ppid,user,etimes,args | grep -E 'entityos|gespraech|agentzero|frank|python|llama' | grep -v grep | tail -80 || true
